about.mission: Help organizations use technology to create useful, meaningful and measurable progress.
about.vision: A future where every business can use thoughtful technology to reach its full potential.

contact.title: Let’s Start a Conversation
contact.description: Tell us what you are building, improving or exploring. Our team will get back to you shortly.

faq.question: What happens after I send an inquiry?
faq.answer: A member of our team will review your message and contact you within one business day.

faq.question: Can you work with our existing team?
faq.answer: Yes. We can work as an embedded partner alongside your in-house team.

faqs.question: What does Wepzo Technologies do?
faqs.answer: We provide web and mobile development, software solutions, product design, digital marketing, cloud services and technology consulting.

faqs.question: Can you support a project from idea to launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can help with discovery, planning, design, development, testing, launch and ongoing support.

faqs.question: How do you estimate project costs?
faqs.answer: We first understand your goals and requirements, then provide a clear scope, timeline and estimate before work begins.

faqs.question: Which technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We choose technologies based on the product, your team and long-term needs. Our experience includes modern web, mobile and cloud platforms.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer monitoring, updates, improvements and support plans tailored to your product.

faqs.question: How can I apply for a role?
faqs.answer: Send your details and a link to your work through the Careers section. Our team will reach out if there is a fit.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number and message when you contact us or apply for a role.

sections.title: How We Use Information
sections.body: We use information to respond to enquiries, provide services, improve our website and meet legal obligations.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect the information entrusted to us.

sections.title: Cookies and Analytics
sections.body: This website may use essential cookies and aggregated analytics to understand site performance and improve the experience.

sections.title: Third Parties and Your Rights
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. You may contact us to request access, correction or deletion where applicable.

sections.title: Website Usage
sections.body: You may use this website for lawful purposes and agree not to interfere with its operation or security.

sections.title: Services and Payments
sections.body: Project scope, delivery milestones and payment terms are defined in a separate written agreement before work begins.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.body: Website content and materials belong to Wepzo Technologies or their respective owners. Project ownership is set out in the applicable agreement.

sections.title: User Responsibilities
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of information you provide and for keeping your account credentials secure.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability and Changes
sections.body: We work to keep this website accurate and available, but provide it as-is. We may update these terms from time to time.
